title: Tensor base change of an independently chosen open affine triple
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X_0,Y_0$ be schemes over $S$, and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be an $S$-morphism [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $g_0:Y_0\to S$ for the structure map. Let $W_0\subset S$, $V_0\subset Y_0$, $U_0\subset X_0$ be opens with $V_0\subset g_0^{-1}(W_0)$ and $U_0\subset f_0^{-1}(V_0)$. Let $R,B,C$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebra structures on $B,C$, and let $\phi:B\to C$ be an $R$-algebra map. Suppose isomorphisms $e_0:W_0\cong\operatorname{Spec}R$, $e_B:V_0\cong\operatorname{Spec}B$, $e_C:U_0\cong\operatorname{Spec}C$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points, def-weil-affine-spectrum] identify the restricted structure map $V_0\to W_0$ with $\operatorname{Spec}(R\to B)$ and the restricted map $U_0\to V_0$ with $\operatorname{Spec}\phi$. Let $t:T\to S$ be any scheme map, $A$ an $R$-algebra, and $e_A:t^{-1}(W_0)\cong\operatorname{Spec}A$ an isomorphism identifying the restricted map $t^{-1}(W_0)\to W_0$ with $\operatorname{Spec}(R\to A)$. Put $X_T=X_0\times_S T$, $Y_T=Y_0\times_S T$ and let $f_T:X_T\to Y_T$ be the base change of $f_0$, with first source projection $p_X:X_T\to X_0$. There exist opens $V\subset Y_T$, $U\subset X_T$ with $U\subset f_T^{-1}(V)$, such that $U=p_X^{-1}(U_0)$ and the arrow $f_T|_U:U\to V$ is isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}(\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\phi):\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_R C)\to\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_R B)$ [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra]. No flatness, finite presentation, affineness of $t$, or directed-system assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Set VT=pY⁻¹(V₀), UT=pX⁻¹(U₀), WT=t⁻¹(W₀). The original containment and the Over commuting equation show U₀ lies over W₀. The pullback equations give VT and UT contained in the inverse image of WT under the second projections, and UT⊆fT⁻¹(VT). Apply Scheme.Hom.isPullback_resLE to the two original pullback squares. Their intersection condition simplifies by these containments. Their induced maps to W₀ are respectively q=g₀.resLE and g≫q with g=f₀.resLE; equality is checked after the mono W₀.ι. Their isoPullback maps yield an arrow isomorphism from fT.resLE to the morphism between the two pullbacks of g over WT. Its commuting square is checked by pullback.hom_ext; both first and second projection identities follow after composing with the corresponding open inclusion.

Apply the existing private tensor_pullback_arrow theorem from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBasePieceTensorBaseChangeInstance, made available by a proof-only import all. Its arguments are g=f₀.resLE, q=g₀.resLE, s=t.resLE, the four spectrum models, and hB.symm, hC.symm, ht. The theorem transports the pullback arrow to Spec(id_A ⊗ φ). Compose this arrow isomorphism with the geometric restriction comparison of step 1 and retain UT=pX⁻¹(U₀). This reuses the tensor transport ingredient of the cited node without applying its more specialized open-chart conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_triple_tensor_base_change
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (X₀ Y₀ : Over S) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    (W₀ : S.Opens) (V₀ : Y₀.left.Opens) (U₀ : X₀.left.Opens)
    (hVW : V₀ ≤ Y₀.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W₀) (hUV : U₀ ≤ f₀.left ⁻¹ᵁ V₀)
    (R B C : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra R B] [Algebra R C]
    (φ : B →ₐ[R] C)
    (e0 : W₀.toScheme ≅ Spec R) (eB : V₀.toScheme ≅ Spec B)
    (eC : U₀.toScheme ≅ Spec C)
    (hB : eB.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)) =
      Y₀.hom.resLE W₀ V₀ hVW ≫ e0.hom)
    (hC : eC.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) =
      f₀.left.resLE V₀ U₀ hUV ≫ eB.hom)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (t : T ⟶ S) (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra R A]
    (eA : (t ⁻¹ᵁ W₀).toScheme ≅ Spec A)
    (ht : t.resLE W₀ _ le_rfl ≫ e0.hom =
      eA.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))) :
    let F := ((Over.pullback t).map f₀).left
    ∃ (V : ((Over.pullback t).obj Y₀).left.Opens)
      (U : ((Over.pullback t).obj X₀).left.Opens) (h : U ≤ F ⁻¹ᵁ V),
      U = (pullback.fst X₀.hom t) ⁻¹ᵁ U₀ ∧
      Nonempty (Arrow.mk (F.resLE V U h) ≅
        Arrow.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId A A) φ).toRingHom)))
